title: Authenticated GitHub Actions Run-Identity and Source-Revision API Readback
live_observation: Public web GitHub Actions and API endpoints inaccessible; connected GitHub search only provides PR-filtered associated runs, which returned none for the previous inspected commit.
workflow_run_probe: GITHUB_TOKEN actions:read makes read-only API requests for current GITHUB_RUN_ID and GITHUB_SHA, saves source/response digest inventory; runs may be in_progress so output is noncertifying.
api_evidence_boundaries: Exact repository DavidWise01/oasis and workflow file path are required
API run ID, exact 40-digit source commit, event, status and conclusion are matched
Run-bound qualification job must be unique, completed and successful with observed steps
Qualification artifact must be present, nonempty, nonexpired and bound to matching run
Pagination incompleteness fails closed; exact API JSON response bytes are hashed
An observed GitHub API response is not proof of independently controlled external custody, physical device origin, or binary/log attestation
An in-progress current run can never self-report terminal success
Absent or inaccessible API observations remain unverified; no imagined PASS
